items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...I certainly think Leslie Nelson must have been marvelous. I just wish I could have heard him once to know what he sounded like. [INTERVIEWEE] He had a beautiful style and got a beautiful tone out of the morning, out of a tenor.

ctx.x: And I'm old enough to be his father.

You know, I think there's so many wonderful players here that have been neglected like that, too. I don't think Ronnie's ever gotten his due, and I certainly think Leslie Nelson must have been marvelous. I just wish I could have heard him once to know what he sounded like.
He had a beautiful style and got a beautiful tone out of the morning, out of a tenor. Uh-huh. And just as dry as a boy.
